name: Insecticides (India) Limited
summary: Insecticides (India) Limited manufactures and sells agrochemicals, pesticides, and technical products in India and internationally. It offers crop protection and nutrition products, including fungicides, insecticides, herbicides, biologicals, and plant growth regulators. The company sells its products through a network of distributors, retailers, and dealers under the Tractor brand. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Delhi, India.
